nodes.label: MSK Scripts Shop (headless storefront)
nodes.rationale: Next.js 15 / React 19 / TypeScript / Tailwind v4 / MariaDB headless storefront selling FiveM resources via Tebex, doubling as the management platform for the Discord Ticket Bot and Giveaway Bot.

nodes.label: Ticket Bot Tiers (basic/premium/premium_plus)
nodes.rationale: lib/tiers.ts is the single source of truth for limits: transcript size (10/100/250 MB), attachments (none/150/500 MB), retention (30/180/365 days), custom domain, attachment downloads, uploads-per-hour (30/60/300); getExpiresAt(tier) derives expiry from storageDays.

nodes.label: Server-side git deploy (CI-gated)
nodes.rationale: Push to main runs CI (lint/typecheck/build); on green, deploy.yml fires via workflow_run and SSHes in to run deploy.sh, which builds and restarts on the server. Build happens on the server so NEXT_PUBLIC_* and TEBEX_PRIVATE_KEY must live in /opt/msk-shop/.env.local.

nodes.label: README Security Summary
nodes.rationale: Private key never client-side, signed HttpOnly/Secure cookies, rate limiting, path-traversal allowlist, transcript upload hardening (extension allowlist, uuid filenames, sharp re-encode), nonce-based CSP, HSTS, account-scoped dashboard authorization.

nodes.label: Security Policy (SECURITY.md)
nodes.rationale: Only the current main (running at msk-scripts.de) gets security updates; report via GitHub private vulnerability reporting or info@msk-scripts.de, never a public issue.

nodes.label: Accepted finding: CodeQL js/http-to-file-access
nodes.rationale: Writing uploaded bytes to disk is the whole point of attachment hosting, so the network-data-to-file flow can't be removed. Dangerous vectors are mitigated in depth (API-key auth, DB-derived guild_id, server-controlled uuid.ext paths, extension allowlist, sharp re-encode, per-tier size limits, locked-down Apache). Dismissed as won't-fix.

nodes.label: Transcript upload hardening
nodes.rationale: Strict extension allowlist (no html/svg/php), files written as uuid.ext so attacker-chosen names can't reach the web root, sharp re-encodes images to strip polyglots, per-tier size limits, custom-domain vhosts locked down (Options -Indexes, Require all denied, FilesMatch allowlist, no PHP handler).

nodes.label: Privacy Policy (EN, GDPR)

nodes.label: Tebex Limited (payment MoR, UK)
nodes.rationale: Shop payment service provider and merchant of record; UK adequacy decision makes transfers GDPR-compliant. Reg. 08129184.

nodes.label: Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd. (subscriptions)
nodes.rationale: Processes Ticket Bot Premium/Premium+ subscriptions within the EU; no card data received or stored by MSK, only customer/subscription IDs kept.

nodes.label: fivestats.io (resource stats, server-side only)
nodes.rationale: Queried server-side only; the visitor's browser never connects to fivestats.io and no personal data is transmitted, only MSK's own resource names + API key.

nodes.label: Session & preference cookies
nodes.rationale: httpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Lax cookies for the multi-step OAuth flows: verify (msk_oauth_state 10min, msk_verify_session 1h, msk_dashboard_session 30d), giveaway (msk_gw_oauth_state, msk_gw_verify, msk_giveaway_session), plus non-httpOnly msk_lang preference cookie (1y). No tracking cookies, so no consent banner needed.

nodes.label: Admin Dashboard Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted Tebex admin dashboard on the shop site: Discord login + own Discord-ID team/permission system, managing the store via the Plugin API without the Tebex control panel. The Plugin secret grants full unscoped access, so it stays server-side and every mutation is permission-gated + audited.

nodes.label: 8-permission admin model + is_owner
nodes.rationale: payments.view/create/refund, coupons.manage, giftcards.manage, bans.manage, packages.edit, team.manage; is_owner=1 implies all and cannot be stripped. Permissions read live from DB so revocation is instant (nothing baked into the session).

nodes.label: msk_admin_team + msk_admin_audit tables
nodes.rationale: msk_admin_team (discord_user_id PK, is_owner, permissions JSON, active) is the allowlist; msk_admin_audit is an append-only log of every write action. Owner seeded once from ADMIN_OWNER_DISCORD_ID.

nodes.label: Admin route auth pattern (authorizeAdmin → rate limit → Plugin call → writeAudit)
nodes.rationale: Every write route: session + permission check + rate limit + audit; /admin and /api/admin/* force-dynamic to avoid router-caching auth decisions; owner can't lock themselves out; OAuth state cleared on all error paths.
nodes.norm_label: admin route auth pattern (authorizeadmin → rate limit → plugin call → writeaudit)

nodes.label: Deployment Runbook (msk-shop)
nodes.rationale: Server-side deploy: full repo is a git clone at /opt/msk-shop; scripts/deploy.sh does git checkout → npm ci → npm run build → service restart → health-check. GitHub Actions no longer builds or SCPs artifacts.

nodes.label: scripts/deploy.sh (server-side deploy script)
nodes.rationale: Builds as musiker15 via login shell; keeps scripts/ root:root so the NOPASSWD-sudo vhost scripts can't become a privilege escalation. Does not run DB migrations (raw schema.sql, no Prisma). Successful states tagged deploy-<timestamp>.

nodes.label: ForceCommand-pinned Action deploy key
nodes.rationale: The GitHub Actions SSH key is pinned via command="deploy.sh" in authorized_keys with no-agent/port/pty/X11 forwarding, so it can only ever run the deploy script. Requires PermitRootLogin prohibit-password or yes, NOT forced-commands-only (which would lock out interactive root login).

nodes.label: Rollback via commit_sha / deploy tags
nodes.rationale: Rollback by re-running the Deploy workflow with a commit SHA, or running deploy.sh <sha> directly on the server; last good states are deploy-<timestamp> git tags.

nodes.label: Tebex API Reference (5 HTTP APIs)
nodes.rationale: Complete reference of the 5 Tebex HTTP APIs (Plugin, Headless, Checkout, Game Server, Affiliate) + Webhooks, compiled as groundwork for the admin dashboard. Key finding: there is no GraphQL/OAuth creator-admin API; every key is a static full-access secret; store management stays in the Creator Panel; any Discord-ID team system must be built on our side.

nodes.label: Plugin API (plugin.tebex.io)
nodes.rationale: X-Tebex-Secret header auth, 500 req/5min rate limit. Manageable: payments (create manual/free via price:0, refund/chargeback, notes), gift cards (full CRUD), coupons (create/read/delete, no edit), bans (create/read, no unban), package name/price/visibility, lookups. Not possible: create/delete packages, categories, sales, settings, gateways, team accounts.

nodes.label: Headless API (headless.tebex.io)
nodes.rationale: Public Token in path + optional Private Key (HTTP Basic) for user-specific calls. Read catalog + build baskets + send to checkout only; all mutations touch a basket or a customer's subscription tier, never the store catalog. Already used by lib/tebex.ts and /api/basket/*. Not an admin API.

nodes.label: Checkout API (checkout.tebex.io)
nodes.rationale: Ad-hoc products at dynamic prices without a webstore (Project ID + Private Key HTTP Basic). BLOCKER for FiveM: requires compliance-team approval and is not available for certain UGC creators on FiveM/RedM. Must be cleared with Tebex before relying on it.

nodes.label: Tebex Webhooks (two-stage HMAC-SHA256)
nodes.rationale: X-Signature header: SHA256-hash the raw body first, then HMAC-SHA256 that hash with the webhook secret — differs from the existing GitHub-Sponsors webhook which HMACs the body directly. validation.webhook handshake on endpoint creation; IP allowlist 18.209.80.3 / 54.87.231.232.

nodes.label: Game Server API
nodes.rationale: Server-side command-execution interface consumed by the official game-server plugins (X-Tebex-Secret); most stores never call it directly.

nodes.label: Affiliate API (affiliate.tebex.io)
nodes.rationale: Bearer-auth API for approved hosting partners offering one-click Tebex setup; not relevant to this shop. Its setup webhook uses single-stage HMAC (unlike the two-stage payment webhooks).

nodes.label: Admin dashboard implications
nodes.rationale: Buildable via Plugin API (server-side proxy, secret never client-side, gated per Discord ID like msk_garage admin): payments incl. free package, gift cards, coupons, bans, package edits, lookups, webhooks. Not buildable via API (stays in Creator Panel): create/delete packages, categories, sales, settings, team accounts, edit coupons, unban. Every key grants full unscoped access, so all mutations must be server-side + permission-gated.
